blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Oct. 8, 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court resumes proceedings on Thursday for Day 36 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, with the House prosecution panel expected to present a Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) official to testify on her and husband Manases “Mans” Carpio’s tax records and financial declarations.

items: BIR Office of the Commissioner chief of staff lawyer Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez is set to take the witness stand as the prosecution’s 26th witness for Article II, which involves allegations of unexplained wealth.
Garcia-Marquez is expected to testify on Duterte and Carpio’s income tax returns, audited financial statements and tax compliance records.
The prosecution is expected to go through financial records covering Duterte, Carpio and nearly 20 entities, highlighting amounts and transactions considered relevant to its case.
The BIR testimony will follow the presentation of remaining representatives from insurance companies, who are expected to authenticate policies and investments linked to Duterte and Carpio. /dp
